model_inference: none; the real offline Pi process loads the package and handles its RPC command
runtime_boundary: Pi CLI, extension loading, lifecycle and widget-host feature paths are real; only provider inference is omitted.

cases.name: extension_load

assertions.expected: The actual Pi RPC command inventory includes widget-host:status

cases.name: happy_path

assertions.expected: The real host handles /widget-host:status and reports the enabled demo provider as active
assertions.observed:

cases.name: error_path

assertions.expected: Malformed host config is contained; the real status command handles the request using safe defaults
assertions.observed:
{"prompt":{"id":"feature","type":"response","command":"prompt","success":true,"data":{"disposition":"handled"}},"notification":{"type":"extension_ui_request","id":"66301b69-10b0-4f09-874a-eb1f8bf98313","method":"notify","message":"Setup: not yet

cases.name: reload_cleanup

assertions.expected: A second actual Pi process after disposal registers widget-host:status
The second actual Pi process handles the status command and returns the demo-provider feature result
assertions.observed:
{"prompt":{"id":"feature","type":"response","command":"prompt","success":true,"data":{"disposition":"handled"}},"notification":{"type":"extension_ui_request","id":"40838003-7e7a-4fd6-a6b1-4683c7752ef4","method":"notify","message":"Setup: done
Preset: Always demo (morning)
Demo provider: enabled
Active provider: pi-widget-host.demo","notifyType":"info"}}

assertions.expected: Both actual Pi processes complete session shutdown with exit code 0 and no unhandled/shutdown errors
The native host shell launches the locally pinned Pi CLI and prints exactly its installed version
